report: Checked all 15 candidate lemmas. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by a different ASV rendering: לְ on/unrepresented/to (81.3 temporal on; 81.9 bare object of worship under rule 40; 81.11 to), לִי unto/of (81.11 'would none of me'), waw and/So/But/also, article the/unrepresented (81.7 bare 'trouble'), לֹא not/none/no (81.9 and 81.11 recast negation under rule 15), עַל at/against, עַם with and without vocative O. No split.

Read the dump for added units against folded helpers: 'Where' (81.5), 'That' (81.12) and 'A Psalm' (81.0) are each supplied over a clause or slot no morpheme reaches; the second 'That' of 81.13 is לוּ's distributed optative scope over an asyndetic colon (rule 25's scope reasoning), which differs from 81.12, where no earlier subordinator's scope reaches the clause. The 'that' of 81.5 rests on the written construct state of שְׂפַת and goes to the clause's verb as rectum, with the competing rule-55 reading named in the note. Consistent.

81.16 second 'with' on the Hiphil שָׂבֵעַ (double accusative, rule 33's direct-object paragraph sending it to rule 44) and first 'with' on the partitive מִן are both licensed as placed; the verse note records the competing rule-33 reading.
BSB disagreement at 81.9 לְ (worship takes a bare object) is the documented rule-40 convention difference, not an error.

The 7 repeated notes flagged by the validator restate contract rules (12, 15, 19, 29, 14, 24) and need no convention. Nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already says; no promotions or amendments.
